title: Multiplying Fractions Word Problems: Scaling Up
intro: Use one full copy and an extra part to explain multiplication by a fraction greater than one.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Model the original amount, then add the fractional extra copy. Connect both parts to the product.

Ask your student

Why should the result be greater than the starting amount?

If your student needs help

If the student treats every fraction as less than one, locate the multiplier relative to one first.
